channel.title: Awesome Blender — Recently Added
channel.description: Latest curated Blender add-ons, AI & MCP tools, 3D assets, standalone software, tutorials, and community links.

item.title: OpenSKP Import/Export
item.description: Imports and exports SketchUp .skp files without SketchUp or Trimble's SDK, placing repeated components as collection instances. — https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/openskp-import-export/

item.title: AnyMachine
item.description: Agent-driven Blender pipeline that builds articulated, working mechanical rigs (hinges, hydraulics, legs, and multi-part hard-surface assemblies) from references with normalized 0–1 controls and GLB export. — https://github.com/apekshik/anymachine

item.title: anymove
item.description: AI motion capture pipeline for any rigged creature (wings, tails, multi-leg rigs) using dual-view AI video, DINOv2 joint tracking, and Blender 5.x to fit the rig frame-by-frame and export GLB. — https://github.com/patch-gg/anymove

item.title: trompe
item.description: Textures entire UV-mapped .glb game levels from a gray blockout by planning walkable cameras, painting views with image models, projecting back onto geometry, and baking albedo maps. — https://github.com/patch-gg/trompe

item.title: Potemkin 3D
item.description: Extends trompe with automatic xatlas UV unwrapping, SAM/MoGe seam and geometry checks, surface relief, KTX2 GLB export, an MCP server, and Blender dcc-sync. — https://github.com/wrong-nebula/potemkin3D

item.title: Patch Toolbox
item.description: Searchable library of 50,000+ free, open-source game-ready 3D models, textures, and rigged characters accessible via web, CLI, and MCP. — https://patch.gg/create/toolbox/assets

item.title: LoopTools
item.description: Essential Edit Mode mesh utilities including bridge, loft, circle, flatten, relax, and space tools. — https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/looptools/

item.title: F2
item.description: Extends single-vertex and edge face creation in Edit Mode for faster quad retopology and modeling. — https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/f2/

item.title: tinyCAD Mesh tools
item.description: CAD-style edge intersection, bisector, XALL, and circle-from-points utilities for Edit Mode. — https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/tinycad-mesh-tools/

item.title: Bool Tool
item.description: Streamlines non-destructive and destructive Boolean workflows with viewport shortcuts. — https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/bool-tool/

item.title: IvyGen
item.description: Procedurally grows realistic ivy and climbing vegetation across mesh surfaces in Blender. — https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/ivygen/

item.title: Archimesh
item.description: Generates parametric architectural elements including rooms, doors, windows, stairs, and roofs. — https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/archimesh/

item.title: Sun Position
item.description: Positions the sun lamp and Sky texture accurately by geographic coordinates, date, and time. — https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/sun-position/

item.title: Cell Fracture
item.description: Shatters meshes into Voronoi-based rigid-body fragments for destruction simulations in Blender. — https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/cell-fracture/

item.title: Copy Attributes Menu
item.description: Adds a Ctrl+C popup menu to copy transforms, modifiers, constraints, and properties between objects. — https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/copy-attributes-menu/

item.title: Amaranth
item.description: Studio productivity tweaks, render helpers, and UI shortcuts maintained by Blender Studio. — https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/amaranth/

item.title: Blender Agent Studio
item.description: Open-source Blender AI plugin and skill suite for Claude Code and Codex that produces editable .blend scenes, Python scripts, and visually reviewed renders locally. — https://github.com/ifBars/blender-agent-studio

item.title: blender-mcp-bridge
item.description: MCP bridge with 93 tools for Blender modeling, sculpting, architecture/MEP, materials, and 3D-print prep, plus a visual record/replay session editor. — https://github.com/seehiong/blender-mcp-bridge

item.title: bpy-dev/blender-mcp
item.description: Enhanced Blender MCP distribution offering standalone bpy execution, runtime API documentation lookup, and benchmark tooling. — https://github.com/bpy-dev/blender-mcp

item.title: Blender Assembly Skill
item.description: Geometry-planning agent skill for Blender MCP workflows that verifies connections, primitive scaling, rotations, and object overlaps to prevent common AI modeling errors. — https://github.com/ProfRino/Blender-MCP-Assembly-Skill

item.title: dcc-mcp-blender
item.description: Typed Blender MCP add-on in the multi-DCC dcc-mcp ecosystem enabling AI agents to model, edit UVs, rig, build materials, and render scenes. — https://github.com/dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-blender

item.title: ComfyUI-BlenderAI-node
item.description: Popular node-based ComfyUI integration inside Blender for AI model generation, texture enhancement, and AI-assisted rendering. — https://github.com/AIGODLIKE/ComfyUI-BlenderAI-node

item.title: BlenderAIStudio
item.description: Next-generation AI workflow studio add-on for Blender built on the Addon UI-Forge framework by AIGODLIKE. — https://github.com/AIGODLIKE/BlenderAIStudio

item.title: fal.ai for Blender
item.description: Official Blender 4.2+ extension from fal.ai integrating Text/Image-to-3D (Meshy, Hunyuan3D, Tripo, Rodin), PBR material synthesis, AI rendering, video, and audio workflows into the 3D Viewport and VSE (requires fal.ai API key). — https://github.com/fal-ai/fal-blender-extension

item.title: UniRig
item.description: Universal AI automatic skeletal rigging and skinning framework (SIGGRAPH 2025) by Tsinghua & VAST with Blender workflow and VRM add-on integration. — https://github.com/VAST-AI-Research/UniRig

item.title: Tripo 3D for Blender
item.description: Official open-source Blender extension for Tripo AI enabling Text/Image-to-3D generation and textured, rig-ready asset imports inside the viewport sidebar. — https://github.com/Tripo-Developer/tripo-3d-for-blender

item.title: Meshy for Blender
item.description: Official local bridge plugin from Meshy AI for sending static or rigged/animated 3D assets directly into Blender alongside mesh cleanup and 3D-print tools. — https://docs.meshy.ai/en/webapp/plugins/blender/introduction

item.title: trellisblender
item.description: Blender sidebar integration for Microsoft's TRELLIS and TRELLIS.2 models supporting local Text-to-3D and Image-to-3D generation. — https://github.com/FishWoWater/trellis_blender

item.title: ComfyUI-Hunyuan3d-2-1
item.description: ComfyUI wrapper for Hunyuan3D-2.1 bringing fully open-source PBR texture synthesis workflows to Blender + ComfyUI pipelines. — https://github.com/visualbruno/ComfyUI-Hunyuan3d-2-1

item.title: ComfyUI-LATO2
item.description: ComfyUI low-poly remeshing node designed to convert dense AI-generated meshes (TRELLIS.2, Hunyuan3D, 3D scans) into clean quad/low-poly topology. — https://github.com/sakalond/ComfyUI-LATO2

item.title: SceneWeaver
item.description: NeurIPS 2025 extensible, self-reflective agent framework for all-in-one 3D scene synthesis built on Infinigen and Blender. — https://github.com/Scene-Weaver/SceneWeaver

item.title: BlenderWorld
item.description: Visual agent benchmark by QwenLM containing 223 tasks and 2,651 criteria evaluating editable 3D Blender scene creation from real-world references. — https://github.com/QwenLM/BlenderWorld

item.title: BlenderGym
item.description: CVPR VLM benchmark evaluating code-based 3D graphics editing in Blender across 245 scenes (procedural geometry, lighting, materials, blend shapes, and placement). — https://github.com/richard-guyunqi/BlenderGym-Open

item.title: BlenderAlchemy
item.description: ECCV 2024 Stanford research framework treating VLM-driven 3D Blender scene edits as iterative visual programs. — https://github.com/ianhuang0630/BlenderAlchemyOfficial

item.title: Kenney 3D Assets
item.description: Hundreds of clean CC0 low-poly and game-ready 3D models ready for Blender and game engines. — https://kenney.nl/assets/category:3D

item.title: Fab (Quixel Megascans)
item.description: Epic Games' unified 3D marketplace featuring the entire permanently free Quixel Megascans library alongside free and commercial assets for Blender and other DCC tools. — https://www.fab.com/

item.title: Quaternius Universal Animation Library
item.description: Free game-ready humanoid animation pack distributed in clean FBX and GLB formats. — https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary.html

item.title: ACCAD Open Motion Project
item.description: Open motion capture archive (.bvh / .c3d) from Ohio State University covering locomotion, martial arts, and everyday motions. — https://accad.osu.edu/research/motion-lab/mocap-system-and-data

item.title: AMASS
item.description: Large-scale archive unifying 15+ optical motion capture datasets (including CMU) into a standard SMPL human skeleton representation. — https://amass.is.tue.mpg.de/

item.title: FreeMocap
item.description: Free, open-source markerless 3D motion capture studio using standard cameras/webcams with built-in Blender scene and rig export. — https://freemocap.org/

item.title: GVHMR
item.description: Gravity-aware AI 3D human motion recovery from single-camera monocular video for animation and SMPL/Blender pipelines. — https://github.com/zju3dv/GVHMR

item.title: DeepMotion
item.description: Cloud AI video-to-mocap tool capturing full-body, hand, and facial motion with FBX, BVH, and GLB exports for Blender. — https://www.deepmotion.com/

item.title: Move.ai
item.description: Markerless single- and multi-camera AI motion capture with production FBX export. — https://www.move.ai/

item.title: Plask
item.description: Browser-based AI video-to-mocap and keyframe cleanup platform exporting FBX and BVH animations. — https://plask.ai/en-US

item.title: Blender Studio Open Movies
item.description: Official production .blend files, rigs, and open-movie breakdown scenes from Blender Studio. — https://studio.blender.org/films/

item.title: Blender Open Data
item.description: Official Cycles and hardware performance benchmark .blend scenes and open test database. — https://opendata.blender.org/

item.title: NVIDIA ORCA
item.description: Open Research Content Archive hosting large-scale PBR and ray-tracing benchmark scenes such as Amazon Lumberyard Bistro. — https://developer.nvidia.com/orca

item.title: Disney Moana Island Scene
item.description: Production OpenUSD Motunui Island dataset released by Walt Disney Animation Studios for large-scale instancing and lighting tests. — https://www.disneyanimation.com/resources/moana-island-scene/

item.title: Agora Community Assets
item.description: Free studio-grade character rigs for Blender animation study (free account required). — https://agora.community/assets

item.title: P2Design Academy
item.description: Free Blender character and body-mechanics practice rigs created by Pierrick Picaut (free account required). — https://www.p2design-academy.com/
